data.summary: Every figure matches Amazon's reported FY2022 results as I recall them: revenue of $514.0B (+9.4%), gross profit of $225.2B (43.8% margin), operating income of $12.2B versus $24.9B, a net loss of $2.7B versus a $33.4B profit (-108.2%), and split-adjusted diluted EPS of -$0.27 versus $3.24.
